description: Welcome to the beginning of Summer!We made through the state primary! The candidates for the November general election arenow set. In the Assembly, which has 42 members, there are five republicans and five democrats that are unopposed by a respective democrat or republican. Some races do have a third-party candidate running. Therefore, 32 of the Assembly seats have a republican and a democrat running against each other. Of the current republican seats, it appears that 12 are solid republican win
